stories.headline: US *BANS* DEEPSEEK IN GOVERNMENT
stories.facts: A new Department of Homeland Security order officially prohibited federal civilian agencies from using AI models created by DeepSeek.
stories.caption_line: 🏛️ The US Department of Homeland Security has barred federal civilian agencies from using DeepSeek.

In the midground, dark bureaucratic corridors and sleek office computers flicker with disconnection alerts. Holographic data streams, network hazard icons, and floating digital warning ribbons cut through the scene. Dramatic rim lighting casts an intense electric-blue and warm-orange color palette across the composition, without readable text or logos.
stories.source_title: DeepSeek banned from U.S. federal civilian agencies under new DHS order

stories.headline: WHATSAPP *EXPOSES* SECRET BOT PROMPTS
